integrity: The proof reconstructs the conditional Dirichlet spacing law, derives the largest-spacing mean by inclusion-exclusion, Poissonizes it through the exponential generating function of harmonic numbers, and differentiates the Poisson expectation to obtain the covariance. Exact symbolic coefficient checks supplement but do not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The process is homogeneous Poisson with constant positive rate.
The longest gap includes the initial and terminal boundary gaps of the fixed observation window.
The result is a mixed first moment; it does not determine the full joint law of arrival count and longest gap.
Older maximal-spacing or random-division literature may encode the same covariance under different notation.
title: Arrival count and longest idle gap have an exact negative covariance
